description: The developer's payout account (Stripe Connect), needed to sell products inside their apps. One account per developer, for all their apps, unless a project has its own (neblla_projects "use_own_stripe"): pass projectId to act on that project's account instead; every action below works the same on it. "status": account none | pending | active | restricted, with chargesEnabled / payoutsEnabled, and what is MISSING in words, one line per thing (missing: [{ key, words, overdue }], errors Stripe found, verifying, filledByNeblla: what Neblla already put there — email, business name, web, the statement prefix), and `message`, a sentence to tell the developer in their language. It asks Stripe every time: call it again when the developer says they finished the form. With no account it says why (lostAccount: the stored one is not on Neblla's Stripe, e.g. one opened in test mode) and onboarding_link opens a new one. stripeReachable: false means Stripe did not answer (error.kind "down": try again) or refused (error.message says why); it is never a silent pending. "onboarding_link": the neblla.com page where Stripe's own onboarding opens inside the developer's Neblla session (no app: the account serves all their apps), where they verify identity and add a bank account (a human must do it; never ask for bank details or documents in the chat: Stripe collects them there, Neblla never sees them); the first time it opens the account and fills in what Neblla knows (email, studio name, the studio page as the web, the statement prefix). A developer who already uses Stripe signs in with it there to reuse their details; it is still a new account of theirs. Paid products waiting for the account publish by themselves once it is active. "dashboard_link": the developer's own Stripe Dashboard (payments, payouts, refunds, disputes, taxes); they sign in with their Stripe login. "set_descriptor" { prefix }: what the buyer's bank statement says before each app's name, «PREFIX* APP» (2-10 Latin letters or digits; Neblla proposes the studio's short name). Only when the developer asks. The account is the developer's: Stripe's fees, refunds, disputes and any negative balance are on it, not on Neblla. "disconnect" stops Neblla selling on their behalf and HIDES every paid product from users; the Stripe account itself is kept, so reconnecting later returns to the same one. It needs confirm: true, and only when the developer asked for it in as many words. Products stay hidden from users until the status is active. Commission: Neblla takes 1 % of each sale, before tax; Stripe's own fee is separate and paid by the developer's account (the charge is made there: the developer is the seller).

prefix.description: set_descriptor: the bank statement prefix, 2-10 Latin letters or digits

projectId.description: A project with its own Stripe (C220): its payout account. Omitted, or a project using the account's: the developer's.
